controls.name: C_commands_actually_execute
controls.must_fire_because: at least half the run-book's commands must be EXECUTED here, not excused. A page where everything is excused passes this checker while being unfollowable, which is the falsifier
controls.can_fail_because: fewer executed commands than excused ones
controls.null_must_contain: a run-book whose every command is annotated paths-only, which spell-checks perfectly

controls.name: C_every_command_is_adjudicated
controls.must_fire_because: no command may be unannotated: an unmarked command is how a command that FAILS gets quietly downgraded to a mention
controls.null_must_contain: a command with no `# CHECK:` marker, which is what an author adds when the command breaks

controls.name: C_no_command_names_a_missing_path
controls.must_fire_because: a command exiting 0 while naming a path that does not exist is a command that silently did nothing; paths are checked in BOTH modes, not only the excused one
controls.null_must_contain: an excused command naming a deleted file, which no execution would catch

falsifiers.name: F_it_only_checks_spelling
falsifiers.can_fail_because: commands are passed without being executed and without a stated reason
falsifiers.null_must_contain: an unannotated or unexplained command, which is exactly what this refuses on
falsifiers.refutes: this row: if the checker passes while a listed command cannot actually be run, it tests spelling rather than followability and the run-book buys nothing
falsifiers.fires_when: commands are passed without being executed and without a stated reason
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

no_deps_reason: the run-book depends on the whole tree by construction, and its commands are EXECUTED rather than read -- a staleness check over spikes/harness would judge other lanes in-flight edits rather than this run
falsifier: a command passing without being executed and without a stated reason, which would make this a spell-checker
